title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Capabilities
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Capabilities practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.

The business units currently hiring are:

Customer

Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let’s redefine excellence together.

Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.

Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX & UI, and Marketing

Enterprise Value Creation

Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa's Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mind

title: Sales Director
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($60M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Sales Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay - strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale - and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works - this is the role.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

SALES STRATEGY AND STRUCTURE

- Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments - how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

- Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

- Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

DATA AND PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

- Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

- Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

- Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back - instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

PROCESS, STRUCTURE, AND SCALABILITY

- Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

- Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

- Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

TEAM LEADERSHIP AND ORG DESIGN

- Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

- Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

- Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

GLOBAL AND REMOTE TEAM LEADERSHIP

- Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

- Proven capability to do this is a requirement - it can't be learned on the job here

EXEC PARTNERSHIP AND GTM PLANNING

- Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

- Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

- Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

- Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion - for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others

title: Category Manager, Strategic Sourcing, Packaging
description:
We are seeking an experienced sourcing manager to join our Packaging Strategic Procurement team!

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies to improve our cost structure, the quality of our products, the reliability of our supply chain, and will play a leading role in supporting innovation through new product development. You will have key responsibilities over SKU ideation and onboarding, vendor selection and relationships, price negotiations and contract management, budgetary planning and continuously improving our end-to-end sourcing process. 

In this role, you will help drive the strategy and framework for how the business interacts with its supplier base and have a direct stake in affecting bottom line profitability.

You will...

• Take full ownership of assigned categories to develop and optimize our supply network. 

• Refine and implement a sourcing and supply chain strategy for a selection of categories that optimizes process, reduces risk, and improves our cost structure

• Build and maintain a strong supplier base that align with our company values; own relationships with our strategic suppliers, including performance management and innovation activities

• Manage cost savings initiatives through our strategic sourcing process to ensure that we hit our targeted budget

• Leverage large internal datasets and industry benchmarks (including market, supplier, and SKU analysis) to drive continuous improvement, identify opportunities for cost reduction, and identify/implement best practices

• Develop a culture of continuous improvement, both internally and externally through data-driven reporting and effective project management to identify and drive opportunities for quality improvement and implement best practices

• Onboard new vendors and new SKUs to drive cost savings and improve customer experience 

• Proactively manage quality specifications and potential issues that might impact ingredient standards

• Work with the Procurement Operations Team to set  execution plans and develop best practices for tracking contract compliance by our vendors 

You are…

• Data-driven - You can organize, explore, and synthesize unstructured data into actionable insights to better inform operational decision-making

• Intellectually curious - You have an insatiable desire to understand how and why things work, identify data-driven insights, and consistently challenge the status quo

• Detail-oriented - You possess strong organizational skills and demonstrate a methodical approach to your work

• A self-starter - You are highly motivated and passionate. You’re eager to take on new projects without knowing exactly what you will uncover

• Agile - You thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environments and are comfortable working autonomously

• A critical thinker - You use logic to identify opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and synthesize and present critical information to solve complex problems.

• An excellent communicator - You can explain complex (often technical) information to a variety of audiences

• Collaborative - You are prepared to work collaboratively across many different HelloFresh teams and functions

• A project manager - You have exceptional project and people management skills

You have...

• 3-5 years of relevant experience working with relevant industries in supply chain operations and strategic sourcing functions; or working in operations strategy focused management consulting 

• 3+ years of packaging sourcing experience preferred

• Undergraduate degree preferred or equivalent relevant experience

• Fluent in Microsoft Office applications (especially Excel and Powerpoint) and Google Suite applications (especially Google sheets)

• Experience successfully leading large initiatives and sourcing events through strategic sourcing processes

You'll get...

• Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFre

title: Law Teacher -University of London (UOL) LLB Programme
description:
Vacancy Name: Law Teacher - University of London (UOL) LLB Programme
Region: Kenya (Kamiti Maximum & Langata Women Prisons)
Department: Legal Education
Work Location: Remote (with several onsite visits to Kenya, where applicable)
Reports to:Legal Education Lead,
Key working relationships: UOL LLB Students, Teaching Assistants & Key Stakeholders
Engagement Duration: 1 Year Volunteership (Renewable upon review of performance & availability)
Hours:12-15 hours over a 12-week semester per module, for two modules (typically to take place between 7:00 AM - 12:00 PM UK Time - to be agreed upon at the time of enlistment).
Mode of Delivery: Virtual classes (either via Zoom/Teams or pre-recorded sessions), with potential flexibility to conduct physical classes in prisons in Kenya, where agreed with Justice Defenders
Advert Opened on: 18th September 2025 (Midday), EAT
Application Deadline:30th September 2025 (Midnight), EAT
ABOUT JUSTICE DEFENDERS
Picture this: an overcrowded and under-resourced prison full of men, women, or even children who have not been found guilty. This is the case for three million people around the world currently affected by the excessive use of pre-trial detention. In many countries, suspects are detained in prison almost automatically once they are arrested. Whatever the offence. Some, yes, are guilty. Many are poor and unjustly targeted. At Justice Defenders , we want to see justice served; it’s vital for all of us. What we don’t want to see is people filling our prisons simply because there was no one to equip them to fight for justice.
Justice Defenders is a registered UK charity and US nonprofit. Founded in 2007, we work across Africa, training incarcerated people and prison officers to become paralegals. Our prison-based legal offices in Uganda and Kenya are run by more than 280+ paralegals. By equipping justice defenders to facilitate a just legal process, we help ensure a fair hearing at the point of greatest need. Everyone deserves the right to tell their story.
Our partnership with prestigious universities, such as the University of London, enables us to provide support for legal education delivered primarily through online learning but, because of the challenges students face studying in prison, supplemented by our programme of learning and teaching support our classrooms are found in men's and women's prisons in Africa, where students are taught by qualified law teachers, visiting academics, and professionals.
Here are key achievements so far by our students studying the University of London (UOL) undergraduate law degree:

• 67 law graduates(including formerly and currently incarcerated individuals, and prison officers)

• 2 High Court Advocates who started as prisoners and now serve as pro bono advocates

• 280 paralegals who have helped 30,000+ clients, with half of the clients regaining freedom

• 14 years of transforming lives through legal education, training, and practice.

We believe we do not just teach law; we cultivate advocates who can transform justice systems from within.
JOB CONTEXT
Justice Defenders is seeking experienced Law Teachers to join our Legal Education programme Teaching Team and support the teaching of University of London LLB students at Kamiti Maximum Prison and Langata Women's Prison in Kenya, and facilitate the capacity development of formerly incarcerated Law Teaching Assistants who have since graduated with the UOL Law Degree. This is an unusual model in that not all of the teaching activities for the respective modules will necessarily be undertaken by the Law Teacher, but by the Teaching Assistant.
This is a voluntary position for one (1) academic year in the first instance, with the possibility to extend the Volunteership period subject to programme continuity and Law Teachers' commitments.
The four subject modules (teaching areas)we will be supporting in the coming academic year are:

• Criminal Law,

• Contract Law,

• Legal Methods and Systems, and

• Public Law

title: Mobility Support Specialist
description:
Calero , the leading technology expense management solution for complex enterprises, is looking for a Mobility Support Specialist to work full-time. As part of Managed Mobility Services, the Mobility Support Specialist supports Calero ’s corporate customers by assisting their end-users with process requests for mobility services with vendors across the world. Specialists provide 1 st line, and where necessary, 2 nd line support, to these end-users with requests including but not limited to: mobile device support, procurement of new devices, sim cards, and other equipment, resolving Help Desk tickets for issues such as data allowances or activations; and providing timely communications and high quality, professional, customer service through a high-volume combination of live calls and chats with end-users. As a specialist you will:

• Provide 1 st line support to end-users through high volume calls, chats, and tickets.

• Respond to customer inquiries and tickets and provide resolution within the contracted service-level agreement (SLA).

• Update required ticketing systems continuously.

• Provide and maintain a high quality of service.

• Partner with the Service Operations Team.

• Adhere to specific guidelines and procedures to ensure tickets are being worked correctly to department standards and client specifications.

• De-escalate dissatisfied customers with professionalism, patience, and support.

• Escalate all issues that cannot be completed within SLAs to management as soon as possible.

• Meet all team metrics and goals, set by management.

• Perform other duties as needed upon request from immediate supervisor.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE required:

• Bachelors’ degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required.

• Mobile Device and Service Support experience desired.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, and Excel).

• Vast experience in working with multiple guides and applications to navigate complex ticketing and queries.

• Experience multi-tasking in a Tier 2 customer service environment, in which clients can submit any requests or issues utilizing various outlets, such as chat, calls, and tickets.

SKILLS and COMPETENCIES:

• Proficiency using and navigating multiple computer applications and systems.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

• Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

• Effective time management and prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing demands.

• Results-oriented mindset with the ability to meet deadlines and service-level expectations.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

• Efficient keyboarding and data entry skills with a high degree of accuracy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including active listening and customer-focused interactions.

Calero is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

The starting hourly rate for this position is $22.50. It is important to Calero that potential candidates for this position understand that compensation depends on numerous factors including the geographic location where the role will be performed, skills required, experience, complexity, travel, and market rate. Calero aims to reward performance and attract top talent with competitive, fair pay and benefits. Please note that the top of the salary range represents exceptional, and/or senior-level positions, that meets all required qualifications. Other rewards vary by position and location.

title: Estagiário em Qualidade de Software
description:
Você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para a qualidade dos produtos que desenvolvemos, ajudando a garantir que nossas soluções sejam cada vez mais estáveis e entreguem uma ótima experiência aos nossos clientes.
Buscamos alguém com curiosidade, iniciativa e vontade de aprender , que goste de trabalhar em equipe e tenha interesse em conhecer e aplicar conceitos, técnicas, ferramentas e tecnologias voltadas para qualidade de software.
Como estagiário(a) , sabemos que você está aqui para aprender e desenvolver sua experiência profissional. Por isso, você contará com o nosso programa de treinamento , que irá apoiar sua jornada de aprendizado e dar a você a oportunidade de conhecer melhor a área de Qualidade e colocar seus conhecimentos em prática.
Tudo isso em um ambiente que valoriza a Excelência . Para nós, isso significa estar sempre “descobrindo maneiras melhores de desenvolver software” . Você fará parte de um time que busca constantemente evoluir nossos processos, aprimorar nossas práticas e contribuir para sistemas cada vez mais confiáveis, estáveis e de qualidade .
Se você gosta de aprender, compartilhar ideias, trabalhar em equipe e quer começar sua carreira em Qualidade de Software, queremos conhecer você! No dia a dia, em conjunto com um Analista de Qualidade mais experiente, você irá:

•
Ser um ponto de referência em qualidade dentro do time , ajudando a disseminar e aplicar boas práticas em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software. Você também contribuirá para esclarecer dúvidas e alinhar requisitos e regras de negócio.

•
Analisar os requisitos levantados com nossos clientes , buscando entender suas necessidades e garantindo que a solução desenvolvida esteja alinhada ao que realmente precisam.

•
Criar casos de teste claros e precisos , de forma que todo o time consiga compreender o comportamento esperado da solução. Como utilizamos BDD, nossos casos de teste são normalmente escritos em Gherkin , mas também utilizamos outras abordagens quando elas fazem mais sentido para cada situação.

•
Executar testes manuais , tanto com base nos casos de teste definidos quanto de forma exploratória, investigando diferentes cenários e comportamentos para ajudar a garantir a qualidade do produto que estamos entregando.

•
Desenvolver automações de testes nos níveis de sistema e aceitação, atuando em projetos Web (frontend e backend) e Mobile .

O que esperamos de você?
Formação

• Você está cursando, a partir do 5º semestre, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas relacionadas?

• Se você tem experiência e conhecimentos alinhados à vaga, mas está cursando uma graduação em outra área, não tem problema! Queremos conhecer sua trajetória. Conte no currículo sobre suas experiências, projetos e conhecimentos que possam contribuir para a posição.

Conhecimentos e habilidades que podem fazer a diferença
Para essa oportunidade, é importante que você tenha interesse ou alguma familiaridade com:

• UI/UX, lógica de programação e metodologias ágeis;

• Testes de software e seus principais fundamentos;

• Programação e banco de dados;

• Sistemas Web e/ou Mobile;

• Testes manuais e/ou automatizados;

• BDD e, preferencialmente, noções de Gherkin;

• Análise e compreensão de requisitos e regras de negócio;

• Boa comunicação e escrita;

• Atenção aos detalhes e olhar crítico;

• Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e compartilhar ideias.

Não esperamos que você saiba tudo! Estamos buscando principalmente alguém com curiosidade, vontade de aprender e interesse em evoluir na área de Qualidade de Software. Será um diferencial se você...

• Já tiver alguma experiência com automação de testes em projetos Web (frontend e backend) e/ou Mobile.

• Tiver outros conhecimentos, experiências ou projetos que você acredita que possam contribuir para o nosso dia a dia.

Tem algo a mais que você sabe fazer e que pode agregar ao time? Conte para a gente no seu currículo! Queremos conhecer não só o que você

At CLEAR we help YOU move forward - because when you’re at your best, we’re at our best. Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We are looking for a hands-on ServiceNow Developer to join our IT Platform team. This person will own the day-to-day configuration, development, and support of our ServiceNow instance, working across ITSM & HRSD while helping extend the platform through custom development and third-party integrations. This is a highly technical, delivery-focused role for someone who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and continuously improving a mission-critical enterprise platform.

You'll work across our development, staging, and production instances, partner closely with IT and business stakeholders, and help drive our upgrade and enhancement roadmap forward.

What you’ll be doing:

- Develop and configure ServiceNow: Build and maintain applications, catalog items, record producers, workflows, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, UI Actions, and other platform components.

- Build integrations: Design, develop, and troubleshoot integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, webhooks, Integration Hub, MCP, and iPaaS platforms such as Workato.

- Maintain and optimize the platform: Monitor platform health, troubleshoot performance issues, optimize scripts and flows, and ensure solutions remain scalable and maintainable.

- Support ServiceNow applications like ITSM & HRSD: Help deliver and improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and HR-related workflows and automations.

- Manage access and security: Administer roles, ACLs, permissions, and other platform access controls in line with security and audit requirements.

- Resolve complex issues: Act as an escalation point for platform-level incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with infrastructure, security, vendors, and other technical teams when issues span multiple systems.

- Deliver enhancements and projects: Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, design solutions, and take work through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.

- Drive platform consistency: Establish reusable development patterns and standards for workflows, notifications, approvals, documentation, and user experiences.

- Support upgrades and releases: Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, test upgrades, remediate breaking changes, and adopt relevant new platform capabilities.

- Document and enable: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, integration documentation, and user procedures, and provide support or training when needed.

What you need to bring:

- Hands-on experience developing and administering ServiceNow, ideally across ITSM and/or HRSD.

- Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow scripting APIs such as GlideRecord and GlideAjax.

- Experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Service Catalog development.

- Experience designing and troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, OAuth, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.

- Strong understanding of ITSM processes and how they translate into ServiceNow solutions.

- Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues across ServiceNow and connected systems.

- Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

- Experience working with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have's

- Experience with HRSD, ITOM, Workday, or identity/HR platforms.

- Experience with ServiceNow AI/GenAI capabilities, including Now Assist.

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and MCP-enabled tools or workflows.

- Experience with Service Portal, custom widgets, HTML, and CSS.

- Experience with Workato or other iPaaS platforms.

- ServiceNow CSA or CAD, or ITIL 4 Foundation

title: Multiphysics Engineer, High Speed Reacting Flow
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Multiphysics Team's work is essential to support our rapid innovation cycle and improve the performance and reliability of advanced defense technologies. Multiphysics Engineers combine computational and experimental methods to size, design, and optimize systems involving complex, coupled physics processes and environments. This team operates with full design ownership through the product development cycle, moving from system-level and first-principles models to 3D simulation and validation/product testing.

About the Job

We are looking for a Multiphysics Engineer to join our team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role you will own the internal flow, combustion, and heat transfer analysis behind air vehicle propulsion systems.

We are looking for strong fundamentals in compressible flow and heat transfer, and a track record of quickly delivering useful results.

What You’ll Do

• Run CFD analysis of internal and high-speed flows, with and without combustion

• Start with hand calculations and 1D models to size a design, then move to 3D CFD to refine it

• Predict heat loads, surface temperatures, and pressures for the thermal and structural teams

• Set up gas properties and chemistry appropriate to the conditions being modeled

• Support rocket nozzle, insulation, and case design decisions with analysis

• Build and document repeatable workflows so other engineers can run the same analysis

• Compare predictions against static fire and ground test data and improve the models

• Support material response and erosion analysis in high-temperature environments

• Work with aerodynamics, thermal, structures, materials, and test engineers

• Present results at design reviews and document the analysis

Required Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. secret security clearance

• 5+ years of experience in CFD, aerothermal, thermal, or combustion analysis

• Foundational understanding of compressible flow including shocks, choked flow, and supersonic nozzles

• Strong first-principles understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics, including conduction, convection, radiation, fluid flow, and transient thermal behavior

• Experience with commercial CFD code such as STAR-CCM+, Fluent, or similar, including meshing and driving a case to convergence

• Proficient in applying hand calculations and 1D models to independently validate CFD results

• Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or similar

• Clear technical writing and the ability to present results to customers

• Passion for defending the United States and her allies

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD in a related field

• Active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

• Experience with solid rocket motors, propulsion systems, or energetic materials

• Experience with reacting flow modeling - finite-rate or equilibrium chemistry and species transport

• Experience with chemistry and gas property tools such as NASA CEA, Cantera, or CHEMKIN

• Experience selecting solvers and flux schemes for shock-dominated flows

• Experience with high-temperature or high-enthalpy flow

ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to help build Cartesia's Product Engineering team as a hands-on technical and people leader. You'll work alongside the engineers building the product surfaces around our models - including Voices, Voice Agents, self-serve growth, billing, and shared product infrastructure - while helping the team grow in size, quality, and impact.

This is a player-coach role. You'll stay close to the work, contribute directly when it matters, and earn technical credibility with the team, while also hiring, mentoring, and creating the operating rhythm needed to ship exceptional products consistently. You'll initially embed with the Voices squad and help establish clear ownership across product surfaces that span teams.

YOUR IMPACT

- Build alongside the team and contribute directly to important product and technical work, especially while the team is growing.

- Lead and develop product engineers through coaching, feedback, career development, and a high bar for performance and craft.

- Help grow the Product Engineering team by personally sourcing, interviewing, and closing exceptional engineers.

- Partner closely with Product and Design to shape what we build, make strong product and technical tradeoffs, and turn ambiguous goals into shipped experiences.

- Establish a predictable execution cadence without adding unnecessary process or losing the team's speed.

- Raise the quality bar through hands-on design and code review, strong technical judgment, and clear examples of excellent product engineering.

- Take ownership of neglected or cross-cutting surfaces - including billing, files, and team rotations - and step into the work directly when needed.

- Help define how Product Engineering should evolve as the team grows, while remaining close to customers, the product, and the code.

WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for someone who combines strong product engineering judgment with meaningful people leadership experience - and who genuinely wants both parts of the job.

- 6+ years of product engineering experience, including experience leading or managing engineers at a company with a high product bar.

- Strong current technical ability and the credibility to contribute to architecture, design reviews, debugging, and production-quality code.

- Experience building polished, customer-facing product surfaces and the product taste to explain what makes an experience excellent.

- A track record of coaching engineers, giving direct and useful feedback, handling performance issues, and helping people expand their scope.

- Evidence of leading through context, judgment, and contribution - not only through reporting lines or process.

- Strong cross-functional instincts and experience working directly with Product and Design to set direction and make difficult tradeoffs.

- A track record of hiring strong product engineers in a competitive market, including personal sourcing and closing.

- Comfort moving between visible product work and unglamorous foundations such as billing, files, operational ownership, and on-call health.

title: Global HR Operational Analyst
description:
HR Operational Analyst

Location: Bangalore

Support Capco’s global contingent workforce through accurate, efficient and people-focused HR operations.

The Role

As an HR Operational Analyst at Capco, you’ll play an important role in supporting our global contingent worker process , helping to deliver a consistent and efficient experience across the contingent worker lifecycle.

Based in Bangalore and reporting to the US-based Global HR Operations Manager , you’ll be part of a global HR Operations function, working with HR colleagues and stakeholders across Capco’s locations. You’ll coordinate contingent worker processes, maintain accurate records, support Purchase Order (PO) creation , respond to operational queries and help meet audit requirements .

What You’ll Do

• Support the end-to-end operational processes for contingent workers globally , helping ensure onboarding, worker changes and offboarding activities are coordinated accurately and on time.

• Coordinate and support Purchase Order (PO) creation and related operational activities , working with relevant stakeholders to ensure information is complete, accurate and processed in line with established procedures.

• Maintain accurate contingent worker data, records and documentation, completing appropriate checks and providing information and evidence to support internal and external audit requirements .

• Respond to operational queries and collaborate with HR colleagues and global stakeholders to resolve issues, maintain consistent processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience supporting the contingent worker lifecycle , including onboarding, worker changes and offboarding.

• Experience with PO creation or purchase-to-pay processes and working with Finance, Procurement or other supporting teams.

• Experience supporting HR operations, contingent workforce processes, HR shared services or a comparable operational environment .

• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with experience maintaining accurate records and working with operational processes and data.

• Experience working with process controls, documentation and audit requirements , with an understanding of the importance of maintaining clear and accurate records.

• Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams, locations and time zones .

Bonus Points For

• Experience using SAP Successfactors HR systems as well as having experience in vendor management systems or other platforms supporting contingent workforce administration.

• Exposure to global HR Operations, shared services, audit activities or operational controls across multiple countries.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know - we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration - a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: ENGINEER/POST-DOC POSITION OFFER : in Stretchable Electronics & Optics for Artificial Skin – 12 months
description:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow.
Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact.
The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you

As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators.
The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be combined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed to create artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.
Within this project, the work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides, as well as on fabrication and integration techniques for optical components (LEDs / photodiodes). A related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure-Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large-Area Stretchable Electronics” (https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523).
The main activities will include:
· Fabrication and characterization of elastomer waveguides for pressure and temperature sensing applications.
· Integration of optically pressure- or temperature-sensitive materials into the elastomer waveguides.
· Characterization and validation of complete sensing devices.
The fabrication processes and experimental setups are already available. However, good knowledge of Python is important for operating and further developing the test benches. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.
The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. This work is part of a European project involving multiple partners across Europe, including ETH Zurich (ETHZ), the University of Oxford, Johannes Kepler University Linz, EMPA…

title: ClickHouse Engineer
description:
ClickHouse Engineer
Singapore (Office-based)| Full-Time
About Us
Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.
We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible - where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.
The Role
We're looking for a ClickHouse Engineer to share ownership of our data plant: a multi-datacentre, multi-AZ ClickHouse cluster ingesting billions of rows a day, underpinning compliance, billing, and a growing family of real-time and historical analytics.
This is a core-platform engineering role, not a DBA role. You'll work across the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also work on the data pipelines around the plant - our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.
You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically - deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.
This hire completes a follow-the-sun team - based in Singapore (office-based) or London - so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid - not goodwill.
What You'll Work On

• Cluster operations at scale - running, upgrading and evolving a multi-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery

• Schema and query engineering - table and sorting-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi-terabyte datasets

• Capacity and observability - a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible

• Ingestion and data quality - correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped

• Workload isolation - keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows

• AI-assisted operations - modern tooling (including MCP-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

What We Need
Technical:

• Columnar/OLAP database engineering - ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb+ or similar) also works

• SQL depth - execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets

• Operational/SRE experience - you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery

• Linux and Kubernetes - comfort with the operational layer beneath the database

• A programming language - one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)

• Engineering discipline - you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly

• Git - excellent version-control practice

• Distributed-systems fundamentals - replication, consistency, failure modes

• Financial services experience is a plus but not essential - domain knowledge can be learned; operational instinct cannot

How you work:

• You own production. Calm in an incident, rigorous in a post-mortem, honest about what nearly went wrong

• You

Desirable

title: Product Manager, New Product Bet (Principal-level)
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

WHY NOW

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

- Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

- Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

- Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

- Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

- Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

- Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

- Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

- Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

title: VSO Job Description
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

Our Fleet Operations Team is responsible for maintaining the safety, performance, and operational readiness of Wayve's autonomous vehicle fleet - from routine servicing and diagnostics to urgent repairs and vehicle readiness for high-visibility events. The team keeps our fleet in peak condition to support testing, demonstrations, and real-world deployment, working closely with engineering, drivers, and operations teams to keep autonomy moving forward, every single day.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day
If you're passionate about driving, technology, and the future of mobility, this role offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of autonomous driving development.

As a Vehicle Safety Operator, you will support the development of next-generation AI driving systems by operating Wayve vehicles on public roads, evaluating vehicle behaviour, and providing operational feedback to engineering teams. You will act as a critical bridge between real-world driving conditions and the engineers developing Wayve's AI systems.

 

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Support real-world autonomous vehicle testing operations across Japan.

- Safely monitor autonomous driving systems during on-road testing and intervene whenever required.

- Provide structured operational feedback to engineers and research teams to help improve AI driving performance.

- Support data collection and validation activities that contribute to the training and improvement of Wayve's AI systems.

- Maintain high operational and safety standards while accurately reporting vehicle, testing, or safety-related issues.

🙌 You should apply if

Essential:

- You hold a full, clean Japanese driving license, held for a minimum of 5 years.

- You have strong driving experience in Japan and confidence operating in complex urban environments.

- You have no blameworthy insurance claims in the past three years.

- You have strong communication skills in Japanese and can remain calm and professional under pressure.

- You're happy working alone and equally happy working within a team.

- You're adaptable, reliable, and comfortable operating in evolving environments and processes.

- You're proficient in Microsoft Office suite or equivalent (Google Suite).

- You're comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and standard workplace software tools - connecting to Wi-Fi and managing settings (brightness, volume, Bluetooth), using basic apps (e.g., Safari, Mail, Photos, Calendar), and troubleshooting common issues (app crashes, restarts, network resets).

Desirable:

- You have an advanced driving background (ADI, Emergency Response Advanced Driver, or similar driving qualifications).

- You have strong familiarity with driving across urban and highway environments in Japan.

Additional requirements:

- Operations run 7 days a week, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and occasional travel support. Shift schedules (rota) are issued at least 4 weeks in advance wherever possible.

- Shift pattern: Monday to Sunday, 40 hours per week/weekend (must be able to work weekends) - 06:30-15:30 or 14:30-23:30.

- Vehicle Safety Operators are expected to primarily work from one of our operational sites in Yokohama or Tokyo, with occasional travel to support operations (as much notice as possible will be given). Please consider your commute carefully to ensure you can consistently arrive on time.

- All applicants are required to disclose any second job as part of the application process.

- All applicants are subject to a health check before/after.

- Employment is contingent on passing training, pre-employment checks and ongoing drug/alcohol testi

Enterprise Customer Success Manager

We’re looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own some of our largest and most strategic relationships with UK wealth managers. You’ll be the client’s trusted advisor after the sale, making sure Aveni delivers measurable value across thousands of users, and leading renewals and growth.

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll take full post-sales ownership of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, each worth around £1m. You’ll be the go-to person for your clients, building relationships up to C-suite level, running quarterly business reviews and pulling in Implementation, Support, Product and our leadership team to drive progress.

This is a senior, visible role with a clear path towards Key Account Director or Customer Success leadership.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Own customer outcomes: Build and run success plans that show measurable ROI from Aveni.

- Drive retention and growth: Lead renewals and find expansion opportunities across Aveni Assist and Aveni Detect.

- Build executive relationships: Become a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders in Operations, Compliance and the C-suite.

- Orchestrate Aveni: Bring in the right internal teams and leaders at the right time.

- Run QBRs: Deliver business reviews that tie outcomes to client goals.

- Drive adoption at scale: Use usage data to find gaps across thousands of users and act on them.

- Represent the customer: Bring the client voice into product decisions.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- B2B SaaS Experience: Customer success experience in B2B SaaS, managing several large enterprise accounts at once.

- Agile Environment: Scale-up or start-up experience (or proven success adapting from a large vendor to a smaller business).

- Commercial Track Record: A proven track record of renewing and expanding accounts while staying customer-centric.

- Leadership & Presence: Executive presence and confidence with senior stakeholders, combined with a genuine eagerness to learn.

- Mobility: Comfortable with regular travel to client sites.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with wealth management or wider financial services clients.

- B2B2C products where success meant adoption across thousands of end users.

- Experience working with AI or data-driven products.

BENEFITS

- Culture & Growth: A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities.

- Time Off: 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays).

- Equity: Share options - we believe in shared success.

- Development: Skills development with continuous learning at our core.

- Flexibility: Remote and flexible working - remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both.

- Health & Wellbeing: Life insurance, income protection, private health care, and a 24/7 employee assistance programme for emotional wellbeing.

- Perks & Pension: Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers, cycle to work scheme, and pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%).

title: Founding Account Executive
description: About Adclear At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. title: Senior Software Engineer, Nexus Server
description:
SUMMARY

As a Senior Engineer, you will get the chance to design, build, and maintain significant portions of our backend functionality for highly scalable, multi-tenant Nexus https://temporal.io/blog/announcing-nexus-connect-temporal-applications-across-isolated-namespaces services (Our durable execution framework for orchestrating work across team and application boundaries for improved modularity, security, debugging, and fault isolation). Examples of the key distributed systems components you’ll own include durable execution, async processing and expand our ability to invoke workflows through more industry standard protocols. Working in the highly collaborative Compute and Artificial Intelligence org, we’ll look to build a new enterprise offering that involves both on-premise and dedicated cloud offerings.

To learn more about Nexus and how our customers use Nexus here https://docs.temporal.io/evaluate/features/nexus#how-teams-use-nexus - [new window opens]

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and implement core backend service features for Nexus https://temporal.io/blog/announcing-nexus-connect-temporal-applications-across-isolated-namespaces.

- Provide appropriate test coverage for unit, integration, and performance for your feature ownership area.

- Clearly document design choices and operational knowledge to successfully deploy and run service with those features.

- Provide appropriate service level logs and metrics to make features operational for cloud service setup.

- Provide appropriate alerts, dashboards, and runbooks for production.

What You Won’t Do

- Work in an office (unless you want to, but you’d be by yourself). Temporal is a fully-remote company.

- Commit code that’s poorly-tested or works “most of the time”. Temporal aspires to be “Reliable as Gravity”, and we expect your code to be the same.

- Work behind closed doors. The SDKs are open source-that means PRs and comments are open to the public, too. See Temporal Git here https://github.com/temporalio/temporal.

- Sit in meetings all day. We mostly communicate in writing, and use meetings mainly for status updates and thorny issues that need input from the whole group.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- At least 6 years of experience in a production environment as an "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer" of highly scalable distributed systems. see HERE https://temporalio.notion.site/Distributed-Systems-Concurrency-2526e6dfce4947d39fd3a40f9f07652a for more info re: "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer"

- Solid computer science fundamentals in distributed systems concepts including multi-threading and concurrency.

- 2+ years experience developing customer facing APIs and Frameworks

- Experience writing concurrent code in production with languages like Go or Java or other applicable languages with skill level as "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert" levels. see HERE https://temporalio.notion.site/Distributed-Systems-Concurrency-2526e6dfce4947d39fd3a40f9f07652a for more info re: "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert levels"

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Agent Marketplace

description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Architect the future of machine-to-machine commerce as a founding member of a zero-to-one engineering squad. You will design, build, and scale the coordination fabric for agent-to-API and agent-to-agent transactions-spanning discovery, identity, billing, and settlement-built directly on top of Kong’s world-class runtime stack. Operating as an autonomous startup unit inside Kong, this team is responsible for lowering organizational drag, unlocking engineering velocity, and establishing Kong’s absolute leadership in the Agentic Era.

 

What You’ll Do:

- Architect and own the end-to-end full-stack surfaces of the marketplace loop, delivering high-performance tools, the underlying REST API substrate, and developer-facing onboarding systems.

- Design the foundational agent-native user experience, creating robust Model Context Protocol (MCP) server capabilities, sandboxed test environments, and elegant CLI/SDK generation workflows.

- Scale and protect the transaction infrastructure by building high-reliability pipelines for programmatic identity verification, usage attribution, granular metering, and complex multi-party settlement.

- Drive cross-functional execution across Kong's engineering ecosystem, partnering with gateway runtime, security plugins, and global core teams to smoothly integrate marketplace features.

- Lead architectural design reviews and champion a zero-technical-debt culture while proactively preventing scaling bottlenecks across distributed backend components.

- Mentor engineers across the organization, multiplying the team's output by translating ambiguous product bets into highly defined, modular, and shippable technical milestones.

- Own the technical lifecycle completely by writing crystal-clear engineering documentation and product specifications for every system you architect.

 

What You’ll Bring:

- 7+ years of experience engineering enterprise-grade production software with a proven capability to design, build, and support complex distributed systems from scratch.

- Master-level expertise with a modern backend stack (such as Golang or similar systems languages) alongside deep architectural command of API infrastructure, Kubernetes, and cloud-native patterns.

- Extensive hands-on experience developing autonomous agent applications, tool-calling systems, prompt loops, or systems designed explicitly for machine consumption.

- Deep operational familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, usage-based metering pipelines, billing integration patterns, or secure data exchange layers.

- Strong written communication and technical articulation skills, with an unwavering comfort operating within remote, globally distributed engineering environments (West Coast/Bay Area alignment preferred).

Law/Legal Job Description
Join Amgen ’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen , if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas -Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease- we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Senior Counsel - Patent Medicinal/Pharmaceutical Chemistry
What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will develop, implement, and execute global intellectual property strategies for Amgen ’s therapeutic products and product candidates (e.g., small molecules and peptides), related to, for example, compositions, polymorphs, formulations, processes, and methods of manufacturing.
The Senior Counsel will work individually and in legal teams and on cross-functional R&D and business teams across various geographies.

This Senior Counsel position can be remotely located , or work from one of these Amgen locations: Thousand Oaks, CA; Cambridge, MA; or South San Francisco (CA) .

• Drafting, filing, and prosecuting patent applications worldwide

• Conducting prior art searches

• Analyzing patents and preparing freedom-to-operate opinions

• Negotiating and drafting research agreements

• Assisting with litigation-related matters and challenging/defending patents in PTAB, opposition, and other forums.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a highly collaborative subject matter expert with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

• J.D. degree or LL.M. degree from an accredited law school, admission to practice law in a U.S. jurisdiction;
and

• Four plus (4+) years of experience practicing intellectual property law;
and

• Registered to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office

Preferred Qualifications

• Ten (10) or more years of experience practicing patent or intellectual property law

• Experience in all aspects of U.S. and foreign intellectual property law relating to biotechnology at a law firm or biotechnology/pharmaceutical corporation

• An advanced degree such as a master’s degree or Ph.D. in organic or medicinal chemistry

• Excellent analytic, legal drafting and oral and written communication skills

• Strong management and leadership skills as well as a strong client service focus and the ability to work independently and in teams

• Ability to work efficiently, to prioritize workflow, to meet demanding deadlines, and to manage multi-dimensional projects in a fast-paced environment

• Experience in U.S. and/or foreign adversarial proceedings (such as patent litigation, Inter Partes Reviews, Post Grant Reviews, and oppositions)

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Kyrgyz 
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping

title: Sr. Investigator, Cyber Security
description:
The Senior Investigator role leads and supports investigations involving cyber incidents, insider risk, data loss, unauthorized disclosure, suspicious user activity, employee-related security concerns, high-risk users, and other sensitive matters requiring coordinated handling.
This is an investigation led role. The investigator will triage alerts, scope activity, collect and preserve evidence, correlate technical and behavioral indicators, document findings, brief stakeholders, and recommend proportionate mitigation actions. The role requires incident response judgment, strong documentation, discretion, and working knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, DLP, identity, endpoint, and threat intelligence tools.
Core Responsibilities
Cyber & Sensitive Investigations

• Lead and support investigations involving cyber incidents, insider-risk alerts, data misuse, policy violations, unauthorized disclosure, suspicious user activity, and other sensitive security matters

• Triage alerts, scope activity, identify affected users, systems, data, and business processes, and determine investigation priority based on risk and impact

• Prepare clear investigation summaries, findings, recommendations, and executive-ready updates for Cyber Security leadership, Legal, HR, Compliance, and business stakeholders

Threat Analysis

• Apply incident response methodology to assess suspicious activity, determine root cause, validate impact, and support containment or remediation actions

• Correlate endpoint, network, identity, cloud, email, and user-behavior evidence to distinguish benign activity from policy violations, compromise, or intentional misuse

• Use threat intelligence and investigative tooling to enrich cases, validate indicators, improve detections, and support proactive risk reduction

Insider Risk Detection & Management

• Identify and assess insider-risk indicators across DLP, UEBA, identity, endpoint, cloud, collaboration, and security monitoring platforms

• Investigate potential data exfiltration, unauthorized access, abnormal file movement, misuse of sensitive information, and risky behavior by employees, contractors, or privileged users

• Monitor high-risk scenarios including employee departures, role changes, privileged access, high-risk travel, sensitive projects, and repeat policy violations

Case Management, Evidence & Documentation

• Maintain complete case documentation from intake through closure, including timeline, evidence sources, investigative actions, findings, risk assessment, and mitigation decisions

• Preserve evidence integrity and maintain chain of custody where required for cyber, employee, legal, or compliance-sensitive matters

• Ensure cases are handled confidentially, consistently, and in alignment with company policy, privacy expectations, legal guidance, and HR direction

Cross-Functional Coordination & Mitigation

• Serve as a trusted investigation partner to Cyber Security, Legal, HR, Compliance, IT, business leadership, and other stakeholders involved in sensitive cases

• Coordinate escalation, containment, access changes, monitoring, employee action, clean-device workflows, post-travel review, or other mitigation steps with the appropriate owners

• Translate technical findings into clear business risk language for non-technical stakeholders while preserving investigative accurac

• Experience in incident response, security operations, cyber investigations, threat intelligence, insider-risk investigations, or sensitive security matters with a focus on APT groups.

• Hands-on familiarity with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, DLP, case management, identity, endpoint, cloud, and threat intelligence platforms

• Experience briefing technical and non-technical stakeholders, including Cyber Security leadership, Legal, HR, Compliance, and executive audiences

• Background in operations security, information security, personnel security, physical security, intelligence, compliance, or security program management

• Strong written
